pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 66 degrees, relative humidity 57 percent, barometer 30.04 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,974 feet, track temperature 96 degrees.

Justin Ashley starts the day with 198 round wins.  All of Shawn Reed's losses to Ashley have been in
Rd. 1.

Ashley is 4 - 0 against Reed in prior events. 

Reed with the starting line advantage, but was up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Ashley kept it hooked up and hitting on all eight to take the win.

Spencer Massey is 2 - 5 in Rd. 1 this year.   Billy Torrence wins 81% of his Rd. 1 races when he has
lane choice.  

Torrence is 3 - 0 against Massey in prior events. 

They swapped lanes after the first pair.

Massey with the starting line advantage, but started to pull the tires loose around 200 feet and
clicked it off.

Tony Stewart is 41 - 17 (71%) in Rd. 1 races.  Clay Millican is 4 - 15 in Rd. 1 when qualified #14.

Millican is 4 - 2 against Stewart in prior events. 

Millican with the starting line advantage, but started to lose traction by half track and clicked it
off.

Stewart started to drop cylinders around 330 feet, but stayed with it for the win.

Maddi Gordon has averaged .070 R/T this year.  The #15 TF qualifier has won in Rd. 1 twice in the
last 3 races at this event.

This is the first time Gordon and Ferre have faced each other in eliminations. 

Ferre with a slight starting line advantage, but Gordon had the difference made up by the time they
went by the Christmas tree and never trailed from there on for the win.  she pushed out a head gasket
around half track with a quick flash of flames.  She will give up lane choice to Torrence in the next
round.

Ferre with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Doug Kalitta's 5 wins this year are tied for the most wins for him in a single season.   The last
time the #16 TF qualifier won a round at this event was 2018.

Kalitta with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Kalitta with low E.T. of the
race day.  He will have lane choice over Ashley in the next round.

Leah Pruett's 1st race in the Pro classes was at this event in 2009. She is 16 - 5 in Rd. 1 when
qualified #3.   This is the 22nd start for Will Smith. He is 6 - 15 in Rd. 1

Pruett is 4 - 2 against Smith in prior events. 

Smith with the starting line advantage and the lead until just past 1/8th mile mark when the car
started to spin the tires and drop cylinders before the engine let go with a big boomer.

Pruett is dropping cylinders around 330-feet and chased Smith down by 800 feet and took the win.

Antron Brown starts the day with 899 round wins. Only 4 Pro drivers have won 900 or more rounds.
This is the 13th time this year Tony Schumacher has been in the bottom half of the field.  

Brown is 48 - 35 against Schumacher in prior events. 

Brown with the starting line advantage, but they both went up in smoke around the same time.
Schumacher pedaled it one time, but couldn't get it to hook up and clicked it off.

Brown drove through the tire smoke for the win.  He will give up lane choice to Pruett in the next
round.

Langdon in Rd. 1.

Langdon is 11 - 4 against Hart in prior events. 

Hart with the starting line advantage, but started to smoke the tires and clicked it off.

Langdon kept it hooked up and takes the win.  Langdon wins the Top Fuel World Championship with the
win.  He will give up lane choice to Stewart in the next round.
